name: promotion-provider
title: Promotion provider
description: Loads promotions, keeps time without hydration mismatches, applies dismissals, shows at most one overlay, waits for engagement or exit intent, and reports impressions, clicks, code copies and dismissals. Includes the shared presentational blocks.
docs: Pass your router's pathname and, for client-side navigation, your Link as `linkComponent`. Set `--promo-highlight` and `--promo-highlight-foreground` to theme the highlight tone. Uses Tailwind v4 container queries.
